expectedRealization.rationale: Spot tanker-rate shocks reprice immediately, but realized earnings depend on voyage fixing, fleet availability and duration across subsequent months.

changeHypothesis.summary: Hormuz disruption produced an extreme tanker/LNG shipping-rate signal. 中远海能 has direct international oil-tanker sensitivity and a purer energy-shipping profile than diversified 招商轮船, but the geopolitical half-life and lack of a frozen cutoff valuation make the edge only research-grade.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Physical route disruption can constrain vessel availability and raise rates while it persists.
disconfirmingEvidence: The event can reverse abruptly with geopolitical de-escalation.
2025 baseline international oil-tanker gross profit at 中远海能 had not been accelerating despite revenue growth.
Shipping equities can reprice before earnings are booked.

causalChain.mechanism: Route risk and reduced vessel availability raise spot freight rates.
Large international oil-tanker/VLCC exposure can capture higher voyage TCE as ships re-fix.
causalChain.failureMode: contract mix, idle time or short shock duration limits capture

losers: energy importers and shippers paying freight
falseThemeMatches: shipping firms dominated by dry bulk/container exposure

pairwise.switchCondition: Prefer 招商轮船 if its VLCC spot exposure/fleet availability is demonstrably greater or if 中远海能's rate sensitivity is already more fully priced.

selectionComparison.rationale: Purity favors 中远海能, but both are valid tanker expressions and the geopolitical/valuation burden prevents a clear edge.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: The March rate spike was already public and tied to an obvious geopolitical event.
expectations.thesisExpectation: If disruption persists for multiple fixing cycles, spot-exposed tanker owners can realize earnings upside.
expectations.measurableGap: The unresolved variable is shock duration and how much of the spike equities already discounted.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Normalized tanker-cycle earnings plus spot-rate sensitivity versus a matched VLCC peer.
expectationBurdenTest.marketBaseline: By late March the shipping-rate shock was well known; 2025 annual results provide baseline exposure but not a clean pre-shock valuation anchor.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: Elevated rates persist for enough voyages to lift 2026 earnings materially above normalized 2025 economics.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: 中远海能 must convert higher spot rates into greater incremental group earnings than 招商轮船 before the geopolitical premium normalizes.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: Rates stay high briefly but normalize before enough voyages re-fix, so both stocks had already priced the event.

valuationExecution.valuationContext: No frozen valuation anchor; event already public for weeks.

bearCase: Geopolitical de-escalation collapses rates before earnings capture, or 招商轮船 has comparable/better spot torque.

invalidationConditions.indicator: Hormuz traffic and tanker spot rates

invalidationConditions.threshold: 招商轮船 shows clearly stronger rate capture
